title: Collections Desk Guide: Collections Handling Charge on Retail Installment Contract Hardship Extensions
content:
**Rule.** A hardship extension on a contract under Retail Installment Contracts carries a collections handling charge set by how far the effective date lies after the next due date:

- more than **30** days after the next due date: the fee adds **10.00**;
- more than **10** days (the product's late-charge grace period) but no more than 30 days after it: the fee adds **5.00**;
- no more than 10 days after the next due date, or with the next due date on or after the effective date: it adds nothing.

| Days from the next due date to the effective date | Collections handling charge |
|---|---|
| 0 or fewer | nothing |
| 1 to 10 | nothing |
| 11 to 30 | 5.00 |
| 31 or more | 10.00 |

**Boundary cases (hypothetical, next due date 1 June).** Effective 11 June: 10 days, nothing. Effective 12 June: 11 days, 5.00. Effective 1 July: 30 days, 5.00. Effective 2 July: 31 days, 10.00.
